messages:
Jill (design): Posting a quick UX pass for Compliance > Settings. Small updates only: retention wording, region routing copy, KMS/encryption states, and audit-log entries. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/example

Mike R.: Suggestion: change the toggle label that says 'Auto-select nearest region' 12 it causes confusion about data being moved. Proposed: 'Route requests to nearest region (storage location unchanged)'.

Anya P.: Retention header should be 'Data retention period'. Helper: 'How long generated content and audit logs are kept. Check regulatory requirements.' Options: 30, 90, 365 days, Custom (inline numeric input).

Samir: KMS state needs clarity. Current 'Encryption: KMS' is ambiguous. Two explicit labels: 'Encryption: Redwood-managed key (default)' and 'Encryption: Customer-managed key (KMS)'. Tooltip: 'Customer-managed keys encrypt data with keys you control; Redwood cannot decrypt without your key.'

Lena (QA): A11y issues to fix before merge: 1) tabindex jumps from retention dropdown to Save, skipping Region selector12 ensure linear focus order; 2) info icon for KMS needs role='button' and aria-describedby pointing at tooltip; 3) badge contrast must meet WCAG AA.

Mike R.: Audit log copy needs more context. Replace terse events like 'Key rotated' with structured plain-text summaries. Example: 

KMS key rotation 12 user: jess@acme.com 12 key id: key-abc123 12 result: old key retired, new key active 

Also include event metadata: IP, region, request id. Keep first line human-readable.

Jill (design): For the KMS badge visual: add a small shield icon + 'Customer-managed' label. Make it keyboard focusable and give aria-label='Customer managed key, click for details' and a sr-only description about key access.

Anya P.: Region fallback phrasing is important. Current 'Fallback to US-West' sounds like data moves. Suggest: 'Requests temporarily routed to US-West to preserve uptime. Data storage remains in the selected region.' Add tooltip explaining routing vs storage.

Samir: Note for backend mapping: older accounts may have a pre-1.2 flag kms_owner=true in exports. Map that to show 'Customer-managed' in UI and add a migration test. I'll open a PR.

Lena (QA): PR checklist for reviewers: focus order test, tooltip aria-describedby present, badge contrast >=4.5, audit event sample in fixtures.

Mike R.: Small copy tweak for the retention helper: 'Shorter retention lowers storage cost; longer retention may be required for compliance.' Keep neutral tone.

Jill (design): Action items: Samir 12 backend mapping + PR; Anya 12 update Figma copy and helper text; Mike 12 change toggle i18n key; Lena 12 add a11y tests. I'll post acceptance criteria tomorrow. Thanks :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Compliance docs updated: https://docs.redwood/compliance/ui-retention-region-kms

Jill (design): I can pair on tooltip aria impl if anyone wants.
